title: ALFooter (al-footer)
description:
Component: al-footer

The site footer landmark and its vertical rhythm. Footer owns the `<footer>`
element, its block padding and the gap between stacked rows. Arrangement is
`<al-layout>`'s job — link columns, legal rows and social clusters are the
page's composition.

```html
<al-footer>
  <al-layout direction="row" justify="between" wrap gap="xl">
    <al-logo></al-logo>
    <al-layout direction="row" wrap gap="xl">...link columns...</al-layout>
  </al-layout>
  <al-divider></al-divider>
  <al-layout direction="row" justify="between" align="center" wrap>
    <small>© 2026 Acme</small>
    <al-layout direction="row" gap="sm">...social...</al-layout>
  </al-layout>
</al-footer>
```

See "Arrangement vs. semantics" in AGENTS.md.

slots.description: The footer content. Wrap each row in an `<al-layout>` to arrange it.

cssProperties.description: Block gap between top-level children. Defaults to `--al-theme-space-lg`.
cssProperties.name: --al-footer-gap

cssProperties.description: Block padding above and below the content. Defaults to three space units.
cssProperties.name: --al-footer-padding-block

cssProperties.description: Footer surface. Defaults to `transparent` so the page background shows through; set it to a sunken token to separate the footer from the content above.
cssProperties.name: --al-footer-background

cssProperties.description: Hairline rule above the footer. Defaults to `none`.
cssProperties.name: --al-footer-border-block-start
